regions.label: CreditsGlyphAlphabet
regions.evidence: Character remapping alphabet. Adjacent lookup loop A5C9 scans this sequence and maps index to tile. Bounded before pointer records; exact bytes reviewed. See round-001/text-structure-review.json and decode-0xac90.json/decode-0xace0.json. Boundary refined to pointer block at 1A60A after exact byte inspection; includes remapped k and two spaces.

regions.label: EndingSpeechText
regions.evidence: Visibly ASCII-like zero-separated lines with 01 terminators and controls; exact end at following LDA routine. Data structural role; ending reachability unproven. See round-001/text-structure-review.json and decode-0xac90.json/decode-0xace0.json. Boundary corrected to encoded A60E text pointer target; preceding 83 remains outside text.

regions.label: ModeMenuText
regions.evidence: Visibly menu strings and delimiters, pointer supplied at A767 to text renderer 89E3; bounded before callable A811 code. See round-001/text-structure-review.json and decode-0xac90.json/decode-0xace0.json.

regions.label: TextGlyphAlphabet
regions.evidence: Consumer AD2E linear character search compares AD41+x and returns tile index+1E. Physical bounded character alphabet including terminator. See round-001/text-structure-review.json and decode-0xac90.json/decode-0xace0.json.

regions.label: StageQuotesAndNames
regions.evidence: Encoded uppercase screen text, line/space controls, terminators. ACE6 loads pointer B319+2*index and ACFE decoder writes translated tile bytes; text boundaries from alphabet end and pointer table start. No claim of execution of every string. See round-001/text-structure-review.json and decode-0xac90.json/decode-0xace0.json.
